title: Deadline-bounded, generalization-preserving BraTS-GoAT fine-tuning and locked confirmation

immutable_baseline.definition: ResEnc-M, five original folds, equal mean-probability sequential ensemble, threshold 0.5, tile step 0.5, Gaussian weighting, no TTA, hierarchy-safe ET subset TC subset WT, no component cleanup, no presence gate, no checkpoint soup
immutable_baseline.protection: never trained into, written into, renamed, moved or deleted; every G82 artifact uses a fresh path; C0 files are rehashed at every stage boundary and required to be byte-identical

candidate_definitions.C0: the immutable baseline; no G82 training
candidate_definitions.T: label-tail-aware subject sampling; native augmentation and native loss
candidate_definitions.DG: native sampling plus exactly one conservative MRI appearance transform

explicitly_excluded: any candidate added after this commit

initialization.from: a copy of the original C0 checkpoint for the same fold
initialization.load: every compatible parameter including segmentation heads, strict=True
initialization.optimizer: fresh SGD, same family/momentum/Nesterov/weight-decay as C0
initialization.finetune_lr_rule: 5% of the original initial learning rate, capped at 5e-4
initialization.schedule: polynomial decay over the candidate's fine-tuning epochs
initialization.frozen_layers: none; the full network is trained

tail_aware_sampling_T.derived_from: labels in each fold's own training partition only

definitions.small_et: lowest positive-volume quartile of ET inside the training partition
definitions.small_tc: lowest positive-volume quartile of TC inside the training partition
definitions.multifocal: WT 26-connected component count >= the partition's 75th percentile and >= 2
definitions.et_absent: exactly zero ET voxels in the training label
definitions.wt_extreme: WT volume in the bottom or top decile

tail_aware_sampling_T.empty_stratum: its probability is redistributed to uniform sampling
tail_aware_sampling_T.cap: every case capped at 3x the uniform probability, then renormalised
tail_aware_sampling_T.region_redistribution: mass of an absent region flows to its nearest available parent (ET -> TC -> WT)
tail_aware_sampling_T.oof_hardness_not_used: forbidden, because it could require opening sealed folds 3-4

appearance_transform_DG.native_augmentation: entirely retained; audited so gamma, noise, blur and low-resolution transforms are not duplicated
appearance_transform_DG.field: independent 4x4x4 zero-mean smooth field per modality, trilinearly upsampled to the patch, max|f| normalised to 1
appearance_transform_DG.apply: x' = x * (1 + a*f) + b*f, only inside the nonzero foreground
appearance_transform_DG.invariants: labels, geometry, dtype, shape, background zeros and finiteness preserved; spatial transforms remain shared across the four modalities and the labels

tie_rules: among tied non-baseline recipes prefer T, then DG, then TDG

full_discovery.reconstruction: unchanged C0 hierarchy, threshold 0.5; no threshold or post-processing search
multiple_passers: highest lower 95% bootstrap bound for delta_U_common_tau1

metric.definition: U_tau = mean(DSC_ET, DSC_TC, DSC_WT, NSD_ET, NSD_TC, NSD_WT)
metric.official_ranking_uses: DSC and NSD at tau=1; HD95 excluded
metric.U_official: organizer-compatible NaN skipping with realized denominators
metric.U_common: each component over the per-case finite-value intersection shared by C0 and the candidate

nan_and_denominator_handling.official: a component that is NaN for a case is skipped and leaves that component's denominator
nan_and_denominator_handling.common_support: components are recomputed on the subject set finite for both policies
nan_and_denominator_handling.lesson_carried_from_G81: under NaN skipping, correctly predicting region absence earns no credit; denominators must always be reported beside means

timing_utc.on_missed_cutoff: do not start the next long stage; preserve C0; terminate only G82 resources; return G82_ABORTED_TO_PRESERVE_RELEASE_WINDOW_C0_INTACT

resource_policy.interruptible_workers: rejected unless checkpoint recovery is proven first
resource_policy.data_path: the retained training volume's datacenter is absent from the pod-create datacenter enum, so it cannot be attached; the preprocessed dataset is therefore staged read-only over the provider's S3-compatible endpoint into each worker's ephemeral disk and verified by count, bytes and sampled content

prohibited: external data or externally pretrained/prior-year weights
validation pseudo-labeling, adaptation, calibration or case-specific rules
mutating any resource not created by G82
governing_rule: A modest, repeatable, common-support improvement that survives sealed confirmation is preferable to a larger validation-only gain. If evidence is ambiguous, retain C0.
